script.title: AT THE TOLL BOOTH
script.story_hook: A visitor pays a road toll for the first time.
script.intro_zh: 第一次開車上高速的遊客，在收費站繳過路費。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, drivers! Today we're crossing a toll booth.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，司機朋友們！今天要過收費站。
script.outro: That's the trip for today! Listen again on the road.
script.outro_zh: 這趟旅程就到這裡！開車時再聽一遍吧。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each toll-booth line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀收費站的對話。
script.char_a_description: a sunburned young woman in her mid twenties with a high auburn ponytail, denim vest over a striped tank, car sunglasses pushed on her head, leaning from a window
script.char_b_description: a kindly toll attendant in his sixties with a salt-and-pepper crew cut, khaki shirt under a yellow hi-vis vest, a handheld radio clipped to his belt loop
script.youtube_title: 【🚧過路費英文實境】「投幣道不找零」怎麼提醒？💵刷卡零錢車道一次分會🛣️上路必備句型｜聽完就會用｜Toll Booth English
script.youtube_title_en: “No Change in the Coin Lane” — Handling a Toll Booth
script.youtube_description:
第一次在美國開車過收費站，該走哪條車道？投幣還是刷卡？這段司機與收費員的對話一次說清楚！從問車道、找零規則到刷卡過關，18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，上路不再心慌。

script.youtube_description_en:
First time facing an American toll booth — which lane, coins or card? This driver-and-attendant dialogue answers it all: asking about lanes, no-change rules, and tapping your card through. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA plus a listen-and-repeat finish.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚧收費站英文｜車道選擇・投幣零錢・刷卡過關｜聽完就會上路｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次開車上高速，遠遠看到收費站，心就慌了一半？
車道那麼多，到底哪一條收卡、哪一條只能投硬幣？

這一集帶大家走進高速道路的收費亭，跟著遊客從詢問車道、搞清楚找零規則，到刷卡、看燈號、順利過關，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🛣️ 問車道與規則：例如 “Which lane is best without a transponder?”、“No change in the coin lane.”。
💳 刷卡與收據：例如 “Tap it flat on the reader, please.”、“That means it's paid, right?”。
👋 道別與問路：例如 “How far is the next exit?”、“Green light — have a safe trip.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次看到收費站的牌子，深呼吸靠右慢——這套句型你早就會說了！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a card up toward a reader
script.title_quote: No change in the coin lane

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, do you lend out transponders here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm du ju lɛnd aʊt trænˈspɑn·dərz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，呃，這裡可以租借電子感應器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here — that's online, or at the plaza.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪr ðæts ɑnˈlaɪn ɔr æt ðə ˈpleɪ·zə/
dialogue.zh: 這裡不行——要線上辦，或在更大的收費站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm just visiting for a few days.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪm dʒʌst ˈvɪ·zɪ·tɪŋ fər ə fju deɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pay here — card or exact coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn peɪ hɪr kɑrd ɔr ɪɡˈzækt koʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 那就在這裡付——刷卡或準備剛好的硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Which lane is best for cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wɪtʃ leɪn ɪz bɛst fɔr kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。哪一條車道刷卡最方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the middle lane; it reads cards fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /juːz ðə ˈmɪ·dəl leɪn ɪt riːdz kɑrdz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 走中間那條，讀卡沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quick question — is change given back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No change in the coin lane, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃeɪndʒ ɪn ðə kɔɪn leɪn ˈsɑ·ri/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. I'll stick with my card, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪl stɪk wɪð maɪ kɑrd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 幸好問了。那我還是刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Tap it flat on the reader, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt tæp ɪt flæt ɑn ðə ˈri·dər pliz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。請把卡平貼在讀卡機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? …Hmm, it didn't beep once.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs hʌm ɪt dɪˈdɪnt biːp wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？……嗯，它一聲都沒嗶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again — hold it two full seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ əˈɡɛn hoʊld ɪt tu fʊl səˈkɑndz/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次——整整停留兩秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah — that light means it's paid, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt laɪt miːnz ɪts peɪd raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 啊——那個燈亮就是付錢成功了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green light, you're good. On you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡriːn laɪt jʊr ɡʊd ɑn ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 綠燈就沒問題了，請直行通過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! By the way, how far is the exit?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks baɪ ðə weɪ haʊ fɑr ɪz ðɪɡ ˈɛɡ·zɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！對了，下個交流道多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next one's about a mile — you'll see signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wʌnz əˈbaʊt ə maɪl jul si saɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 下一個大約一英里——會看到標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Well, that was easier than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜr·fɪkt wɛl ðæt wɑz ˈi·zɪər ðæn aɪ fɪr d/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，比我想像中輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tolls are easy. Drive safe — goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 過路費很好處理。開車小心，再見！
